document.longDescription:
Sweat Toddler's Soccer publishes a dedicated Carroll Gardens page for its Carroll Park program. The official page title and description say the classes are held at Carroll Park in Brooklyn on Sundays and are designed for children ages 2 to 5 years old.

The same official site presents the program as a neighborhood soccer class where children learn soccer basics, stay active, and make new friends. Public site contact details include Registration@Sweattoddlersoccer.com and phone 347-330-3122.

Because the official public page excerpt reviewed here clearly supports the Sunday schedule but not a precise class time, this listing uses a conservative weekend tag set only.

Sources: https://www.sweattoddlersoccer.com/carroll-gardens-toddlers
